interface.signature: captainAmerica(N: int, M: int, V: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: Number of rooms N is between 1 and 30000.
Number of gates M is between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for p, q in V)
preconditions.description: Each gate connects two rooms within the range [1, N].

postconditions.description: The number of rooms Captain America can hide in is non-negative.
The number of rooms Captain America can hide in does not exceed the total number of rooms.
